theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 27 群

items.colloc: make urgent repairs 緊急維修 | make minor repairs 小修
items.distinct: conduct repairs 執行維修 | perform maintenance 執行保養
ex: Technicians will make repairs to the faulty equipment tomorrow.
技術人員明天將對故障設備進行維修。
The landlord refused to make repairs on the leaking roof.
房東拒絕維修漏水的屋頂。
It is necessary to make repairs before we open the store.
我們開店前必須進行維修。

items.colloc: properly make the bed 把床鋪好 | forget to make the bed 忘記鋪床
items.distinct: clean the room 打掃房間 | tidy up the room 整理房間
ex: Hotel staff are required to make the bed daily.
飯店員工必須每天鋪床。
I usually make the bed as soon as I wake up.
我通常起床後馬上就鋪床。
The housekeeping service will make the bed during your stay.
住宿期間客房服務會為您鋪床。

items.colloc: make up for lost time 補回時間 | make up for the loss 彌補損失
items.distinct: compensate for 賠償 | make amends for 賠罪
ex: He worked overtime to make up for his absence last week.
他加班以彌補上週的缺席。
The company offered a discount to make up for the delay.
公司提供折扣以彌補延誤。
Nothing can make up for the loss of his reputation.
沒有什麼能彌補他失去的名譽。

items.colloc: move ahead with the plan 推進計畫 | move ahead with the project 繼續專案
items.distinct: proceed with 繼續進行 | carry on with 繼續做
ex: Management decided to move ahead with the expansion plan.
管理層決定繼續推進擴張計畫。
We are ready to move ahead with the new software installation.
我們準備開始安裝新軟體。
The board will move ahead with the merger next month.
董事會下個月將推進合併事宜。

items.pos: phr. 往旁邊挪一個位子
items.colloc: kindly move over one seat 請往旁邊挪一個位子 | move over one seat please 請往旁邊移動一個座位
items.distinct: change seats 換位子 | switch seats 交換位子
ex: Could you please move over one seat to the left?
您可以往左邊挪一個位子嗎？
She asked the passenger to move over one seat.
她請那位乘客往旁邊挪一個位子。
Please move over one seat so my friend can sit down.
請往旁邊挪一個位子讓我朋友坐下。

items.colloc: constant need monitoring 持續需要監控 | urgent need monitoring 緊急需要監控
items.distinct: require observation 需要觀察 | demand supervision 需要督導
ex: The performance of the new server will need monitoring.
新伺服器的效能需要進行監控。
Patient vital signs will need monitoring during the procedure.
手術期間病人的生命徵象需要監控。
This investment strategy will need monitoring every quarter.
這項投資策略每季都需要監控。

items.colloc: report net income 報告淨利 | exceed net income 超過淨利
items.distinct: gross income 毛利 | total revenue 總營收
ex: The company reported a record high net income this year.
公司今年報告了創紀錄的淨利。
Our net income decreased due to rising production costs.
由於生產成本上升，我們的淨利減少了。
Investors focus on the annual net income of the corporation.
投資者關注該公司的年度淨利。

items.colloc: work the night shift 上夜班 | night shift allowance 夜班津貼
items.distinct: day shift 日班 | graveyard shift 大夜班
ex: He has been working the night shift for three years.
他已經上夜班三年了。
Employees on the night shift receive a higher hourly wage.
上夜班的員工領取較高的時薪。
She prefers the night shift because it is quieter.
她比較喜歡夜班，因為環境比較安靜。

items.colloc: no later than Friday 不晚於週五 | no later than noon 不晚於中午
items.distinct: by 在…之前 | before 在…之前
ex: Please submit your expense report no later than Friday.
請在週五之前提交您的費用報告。
All applications must be received no later than closing time.
所有申請必須在截止時間前收到。
The shipment will arrive no later than next Wednesday.
貨物將不晚於下週三送達。

items.colloc: reduce noise and air pollution 減少噪音與空氣污染 | cause noise and air pollution 造成噪音與空氣污染
items.distinct: environmental damage 環境破壞 | industrial waste 工業廢棄物
ex: The factory faces complaints about noise and air pollution.
這家工廠面臨關於噪音與空氣污染的投訴。
City officials are working to lower noise and air pollution.
市政府官員正致力於降低噪音與空氣污染。
Strict regulations help control noise and air pollution levels.
嚴格的規定有助於控制噪音與空氣污染水平。

items.colloc: order office supplies 訂購辦公用品 | stock of office supplies 辦公用品庫存
items.distinct: stationery 文具 | office equipment 辦公設備
ex: We need to restock our office supplies every month.
我們每個月都需要補充辦公用品。
Please include the cost of office supplies in the budget.
請將辦公用品的費用納入預算中。
The purchasing department handles all office supplies orders.
採購部門負責所有的辦公用品訂單。

items.colloc: be on a business trip 去出差 | send on a business trip 派去出差
items.distinct: on vacation 度假中 | on a mission 出任務
ex: The manager is currently on a business trip in Japan.
經理目前正在日本出差。
I will be on a business trip for the entire week.
我整個星期都會在出差。
You can email me while I am on a business trip.
我出差時可以透過電子郵件聯絡我。

items.colloc: exercise on an empty stomach 空腹運動 | take medicine on an empty stomach 空腹吃藥
items.distinct: on a full stomach 吃飽後 | on a light stomach 肚子不太餓
ex: It is not advisable to exercise on an empty stomach.
不建議在空腹的情況下運動。
He felt dizzy because he worked on an empty stomach.
因為空腹工作，他感到頭暈。
The doctor instructed me to take pills on an empty stomach.
醫生指示我空腹服用藥丸。

items.colloc: travel on business 因公出差 | be away on business 因公外出
items.distinct: for pleasure 為了遊玩 | for personal reasons 基於個人原因
ex: He is visiting Seoul on business next month.
他下個月因公去首爾拜訪。
Are you in this city on business or for vacation?
您在這座城市是出差還是度假？
Many executives travel on business throughout the year.
許多主管整年都在因公奔波。

items.colloc: pay on delivery 貨到付款 | check on delivery 交貨時檢查
items.distinct: upon arrival 到達時 | at the time of purchase 購買時
ex: You must make the payment on delivery of the goods.
貨到時您必須進行付款。
Please inspect the package carefully on delivery.
請在交貨時仔細檢查包裹。
The courier will collect the fee on delivery.
快遞員將在交貨時收取費用。

items.colloc: be on duty 值班中 | while on duty 值班期間
items.distinct: off duty 下班 | on call 待命
ex: Security guards are on duty throughout the night.
保全人員整晚都在值班。
He is not allowed to use his phone while on duty.
他在值班期間不准使用手機。
The doctor on duty will assist you shortly.
值班醫生稍後會協助您。

items.colloc: be on loan 借出中 | get items on loan 借用物品
items.distinct: for sale 待售 | in stock 現貨
ex: That painting is currently on loan to the city museum.
那幅畫目前正出借給市立博物館。
The equipment is on loan from another department.
這項設備是從其他部門借來的。
Books on loan must be returned by the due date.
借出的書籍必須在期限前歸還。

items.colloc: do something on purpose 故意做某事 | not do it on purpose 不是故意的
items.distinct: by accident 意外地 | by mistake 錯誤地
ex: I did not break your mug on purpose.
我不是故意打破你的馬克杯。
He was late on purpose to avoid the meeting.
他是故意遲到的，為了避開會議。
She did it on purpose to get my attention.
她是故意這樣做來吸引我的注意。

items.colloc: finish on schedule 按時完成 | keep on schedule 保持進度
items.distinct: ahead of schedule 超前進度 | behind schedule 落後進度
ex: The construction project is expected to finish on schedule.
這項建築工程預計會按時完成。
We are working hard to keep the project on schedule.
我們正努力讓專案保持在進度上。
The train arrived exactly on schedule this morning.
火車今天早上準時抵達。

items.colloc: be out of order 故障 | remain out of order 處於故障狀態
items.distinct: in working order 運作正常 | out of stock 缺貨
ex: The elevator is out of order, please use the stairs.
電梯故障了，請走樓梯。
This vending machine has been out of order for weeks.
這台自動販賣機已經故障好幾週了。
All the printers are out of order today.
今天所有的印表機都故障了。
